name: daybook
label: Daybook
description: A page per day: your own lines, plus a Draft the day button that turns what actually happened - runs, notes touched, memories saved - into a short first-person entry you can edit. Entries are plain markdown in daybook\YYYY-MM-DD.md, so they are yours and searchable outside the app. The page never overwrites without a save.

steps: Open Apps > Daybook. Pick a date (or use today), type, press save or Ctrl+S. Each day is one file, daybook\YYYY-MM-DD.md, so a backup or git of the app keeps the diary with it.

Draft the day gathers that date's runs (objective, status, tokens), notes touched that day and memories saved, then asks the Agent bar's model for a short first-person entry. The draft lands in the box - it is not saved until you press save.
The list on the left is the last 40 entries with their first line; the search box filters that list. For full-text across every day, the files are plain markdown in daybook\ - grep works.
fixes: Draft the day says it has nothing to draft
No runs, notes or memories are dated that day. That is a real answer: write it yourself, or pick a day the crew worked.
The draft is refused or empty
It is a normal run on the Agent bar's model, not a hidden call: a text-only or unavailable model shows its own error. Open Chat, pick a model, try again.
The page writes only on save; a refresh with unsaved text loses it (the box turns amber to say so). Files are never deleted here - check daybook\ and workspace\.trash.
